title: A half-century of rhythm: T.R. Chandran from Thrissur, a constant at Chembai Sangeetholsavam
description: As Chembai Sangeetholsavam celebrates its golden jubilee, T.R. Chandran has been a regular at the fete since 1977; his wife, Sathi, is also a dedicated music teacher. Music keeps the light alive for this visually couple
